WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () as share
  FROM telescope_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share
FROM ranked
WHERE share >= COALESCE(
  (SELECT share FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10), 
  0.0
)
ORDER BY share DESC
